name: Fairfield by Marriott Surabaya
short_description: Indonesia's first Fairfield by Marriott, a 270-room high-rise select-service hotel on Jalan Mayjend Sungkono in West Surabaya, minutes from Ciputra World and geared to business and long stays.
ai_summary: Fairfield by Marriott Surabaya opened in 2016 as the brand's first property in Indonesia, occupying a slim 30-storey tower on Jalan Mayjend Sungkono in the city's western business belt. Independent reviewers consistently describe it as a reliable, sensibly priced select-service base rather than a resort: rooms are spacious with comfortable beds and, from the upper floors, genuinely good views over a fairly congested city. Service draws the strongest praise across blogs and guest reviews, with front desk, security and housekeeping repeatedly singled out for warmth and for accommodating early check-in. The all-day Kava restaurant and its buffet breakfast (Indonesian, Asian and Western, with an egg station) earn solid marks, and the location suits business travellers, being close to Ciputra World mall and the CBD. Watch-outs are real for the price point: reviewers note the building can be hard to walk out of on foot, with limited paved pedestrian access to the mall, half-height rather than floor-to-ceiling windows, and occasional lapses in room upkeep such as tired carpets and maintenance niggles. Some points-focused guests feel the nearby JW Marriott is a better use of money if rates are close, and there is no executive lounge. Overall it holds a broadly positive reputation as a dependable four-star business hotel with friendly service and fair value, best for travellers prioritising a Marriott standard and location over resort facilities.

pros: Consistently friendly, attentive service from front desk, security and housekeeping, with easy early check-in
Spacious, comfortable rooms with good city views from the high-rise upper floors
Well-regarded Kava buffet breakfast spanning Indonesian, Asian and Western options
Fair value for a Marriott-branded four-star, close to Ciputra World and the West Surabaya CBD
cons: Poor pedestrian access outside the building, so reaching the nearby mall usually means a car
Occasional room-upkeep lapses reported, including tired carpets and maintenance issues
No executive lounge and half-height windows; some guests feel the JW Marriott is better value if rates are close
research_highlights: Opened November 2016 as the first Fairfield by Marriott in Indonesia
270 rooms and suites across a roughly 30-storey tower with the all-day Kava restaurant and Kava Bar
Holds about a 4.0/5 TripAdvisor rating across 400-plus guest reviews
research_watchouts: Select-service positioning: no lounge and limited resort facilities, so set expectations accordingly
The building sits on a busy arterial road with weak walkability; plan on ride-hailing for most trips

faqs.question: How far is Fairfield by Marriott Surabaya from Juanda International Airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits in West Surabaya on Jalan Mayjend Sungkono, roughly 20 kilometres from Juanda International Airport (SUB). Depending on traffic the drive typically takes around 45 minutes, so it is convenient but not immediately airport-adjacent. Ride-hailing and taxis are the easiest way to make the transfer.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included and what is the food like?
faqs.answer: Breakfast is served at the all-day Kava restaurant and is included on many rate plans, though some rates are room-only, so check when booking. Reviewers praise the spread, which mixes Indonesian, Asian and Western dishes and includes a cooked-to-order egg station. Kava also serves lunch and dinner daily.

faqs.question: Is the hotel a good base for exploring Surabaya?
faqs.answer: It suits business travellers and longer stays, sitting close to Ciputra World mall and the western business district with reliable Marriott service. However, pedestrian access around the building is limited, so most guests rely on cars or ride-hailing. Upper floors reward you with wide views over the city skyline.

reviews.title: Review: Fairfield by Marriott Surabaya, Indonesia
reviews.summary: Stay in a Junior Suite praising the high-rise city views and brand reliability, but flagging half-height windows, a doorless wet-room shower, modest amenities and awkward walkability to the nearby mall.
